metadata.title: त्रिपुरा में आदिवासी जीत का जश्न | Historic Victory for Tribes of Tripura
metadata.description: The Centre on Saturday signed the crucial tripartite agreement with the Tripura government, the opposition TIPRA Motha party and several stakeholders in New Delhi following a host of demands raised by the TIPRA Motha’s founder and chief Pradyot Kishore Debbarma for the development of the state’s indigenous population.
